entry: no tag, no bracket, no plan: REFUSED (intent entry)
  [setup-tag] Rationale must start with the strategy as setup:<name> (e.g. "setup:orb long ..."); the tag goes first. If this order exits or protects a position, start the rationale with [exit] or [protect].
  [stop-defined] Entry has no stop bracket: every entry carries its stop as stopLossBracket {ticks, type:"stop"}, ticks a whole number above 0 from the fill and type "stop" (or "trailing_stop"); order_plan gives it. A stop stated only in the rationale is not one. A broker that can't attach the bracket refuses the entry: never send it again without one, and report the broker's message to the user.
  [plan-required] No journal plan for MNQ in the last 120 min. Write one with journal_add {kind:"plan", contractId, ...} (thesis, trigger, stop, target, size, $ risk) first.

protect: with a bracket (allowed by this gate; the gateway refuses it): ALLOWED (intent risk-reducing)
protect: a stand-alone [protect] target (a limit): REFUSED (intent risk-reducing)
  [bracket-only] A [protect] limit is a stand-alone target: no order links it to the stop, so whichever fills first leaves the other working to open a new, unprotected position. Risk is managed with the entry's brackets: modify the bracket's stop/target with modify_order (under a trail or target_then_trail exit the runner manages the exit and wants no target). To take profit or get out now, send an [exit] (market), partial_close_position or close_position.
exit: a limit [exit] (it can rest): REFUSED (intent risk-reducing)
  [bracket-only] A limit or join [exit] can rest in the book: a stand-alone target that outlives the stop if the stop fills first. Take profit by trailing the bracket stop with modify_order (toward the market), or close now with a market [exit] (or partial_close_position / close_position).
exit: a join_ask [exit] (rests by definition): REFUSED (intent risk-reducing)
  [bracket-only] A limit or join [exit] can rest in the book: a stand-alone target that outlives the stop if the stop fills first. Take profit by trailing the bracket stop with modify_order (toward the market), or close now with a market [exit] (or partial_close_position / close_position).
modify: a size change without a reason: REFUSED (intent modify)
  [modify-size] modify_order may change prices only, unless the reason starts with [exit] or [protect] (cutting a protective order after a partial exit; the gateway checks it is a decrease). To add size, place a new order.
